Every source-resolved direct exact focal invoke passes literal null for the listed reference parameters. This proves absence of non-null inputs at those direct sites. Indirect or dynamic calls could still pass other values; the internal reason no non-null direct case was retained remains unknown, and this observation alone does not establish the cause of every uncovered branch.

confirmed_implementation_notes.conclusion: Generation-time minimization uses per-class probe sets over all instrumented subject classes reached during receiver/argument materialization, focal invocation and result observation. Method scope restricts generation targets, while retained-test usefulness is not restricted to probes of the focal method. Receiver setup can therefore retain tests whose direct focal call repeats the same null-input early return.
limits: Per-test sandbox probe BitSets are not persisted in these artifacts, so the exact incremental probe contribution and retaining reason of each of the12 tests cannot be reconstructed without new execution.
This evidence does not establish why non-null CharBuffer candidates were never generated, failed construction, or were not retained; internal candidate-cause remains unknown.
The greedy minimizer has a special one-per-method/outcome rule for completely empty probe maps; this does not narrow its main class-wide probe criterion.
Symbolic uncovered-line steering separately slices focal method lines, so broad minimization does not imply every steering stage ignores the focal method.

all_five_compile_closed_sensitivity.selection: All five tools fully compile their nonempty exported suites and finish a closed nonempty JUnit run. Failed tests, zero coverage and generation exit codes are not additional filters.

confirmed_implementation_mechanisms.conclusion: Generation-time minimization uses per-class probe sets over all instrumented subject classes reached during receiver/argument materialization, focal invocation and result observation. Method scope restricts generation targets, while retained-test usefulness is not restricted to probes of the focal method. Receiver setup can therefore retain tests whose direct focal call repeats the same null-input early return.
limits: Per-test sandbox probe BitSets are not persisted in these artifacts, so the exact incremental probe contribution and retaining reason of each of the12 tests cannot be reconstructed without new execution.
This evidence does not establish why non-null CharBuffer candidates were never generated, failed construction, or were not retained; internal candidate-cause remains unknown.
The greedy minimizer has a special one-per-method/outcome rule for completely empty probe maps; this does not narrow its main class-wide probe criterion.
Symbolic uncovered-line steering separately slices focal method lines, so broad minimization does not imply every steering stage ignores the focal method.

interpretation_rules: Main population is all72 exact original method/version targets; no outcome-based removal or favorable subset selection.
Coverage W/T/L compares covered counters on the same focal denominator. Zero-branch methods are N/A, not wins or ties.
Generation time and token W/T/L use lower-is-less-cost orientation. Failures remain in these comparisons; a low cost is not evidence of useful output.
Token W/T/L requires both usage totals complete. Incomplete/lower-bound usage remains incomparable; observed totals are retained.
Case counts use higher/equal/lower, not efficacy wins. More cases do not establish higher coverage or better assertions.
Source call diagnosis requires exact compiled binding, source line, verified collected source SHA and unambiguous argument spans. Missing evidence stays unknown.

Literal-null-only calls prove absence of non-null inputs at resolved direct focal sites. Indirect/dynamic inputs and whether the constructor, solver or minimizer caused omission remain unknown without further evidence.
Other-overload invocation evidence is distinct from generation failure, no export, compile failure and incomplete JUnit execution.
One seed/repetition is descriptive; no statistical superiority or stability claim follows from this analysis.
Progress snapshots are incomplete and pending coverage is explicitly flagged; final claims require all360 complete.
